30 |     """A `CliEnv` is the user's selection of tox test environments, usually supplied via the ``-e`` command-line option
31 |     or in a TOML file (typically ``env_list`` in ``tox.ini``). It may be treated as a sequence if it's not a "default"
32 |     or "all" selection.
33 | 
34 |     It is in one of three forms:
35 | 
36 |     - A list of specific environments, instantiated with a string that is a comma-separated list of the environment
37 |       names. (These may have spaces on either side of the commas which are removed.) As a sequence this will be a
38 |       sequence of those names.
39 | 
40 |     - "ALL" which is all environments defined by the tox configuration. This is instantiated with ``ALL`` either
41 |       alone or as any element of a comma-separated list; any other environment names are ignored. `is_all()` will be
42 |       true and as a sequence it will be empty. This prints in string representation as ``ALL``.
43 | 
44 |     - The default environments as chosen by tox configuration. This is instantiated with `None` as the parameter,
45 |       `is_default_list()` will be true, and as a sequence this will be empty. This prints in string representation
46 |       as ``<env_list>``.
47 |     """

50 |         if isinstance(value, str):
51 |             value = StrConvert().to(value, of_type=List[str], factory=None)
